reference.description: User-approved encoded subtitle preview; the verified font, size, color, position and spacing values below are authoritative. No reference image is bundled or required.

actualInkBounds.note: Measured on approved 1080x1920 encoded frame; other glyphs vary.

wrapping.preferred: One Chinese line plus one English line; preserve existing cue times and words
wrapping.overflow: Measure rendered glyph width against 990px. Keep one Chinese and one English line where possible. For overflow, break at natural semantic boundaries after checking speech; preserve wording and cue timing on subtitle-only revisions when feasible. Do not silently shrink fonts. Multi-line layouts require collision review; do not cover scene content.

scaling.rule: Scale font sizes, coordinates, spacing and margins uniformly by outputWidth/1080 for same 9:16 ratio; recheck glyph bounds and content collisions; no stretching

approval.scope: Subtitle preview approved; full export and default preset authorized
